name: quota-saver
description: Makes your Claude Code quota last longer. English + Roman Urdu prompts.

setupLocalModel.title: Local model (Ollama) setup
setupLocalModel.description: yes: set up Ollama and the model on the first session, so general questions are free. ask: ask on the first session. no: off (run /local on later).

maxOutputChars.title: Max tool output (characters)
maxOutputChars.description: Bash, MCP and web output longer than this is shortened (errors and the last lines are kept).

maxReadKB.title: Max full-file read (KB)
maxReadKB.description: Before Claude reads a whole file larger than this, it is asked to search or read a line range instead.

dedupeReads.title: Block repeat reads
dedupeReads.description: Stop Claude re-reading a file it already read that has not changed.

autoIntent.title: Auto task detection
autoIntent.description: Detect the kind of task (fix, explain, test, review, build) and attach a short, lean instruction.

localCache.title: Local answer cache
localCache.description: Answer repeated questions from disk (0 tokens). Start a prompt with ! for a fresh answer.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Address of the local model server (for /local).

guardJunk.title: Guard junk files
guardJunk.description: Stop whole reads of dependency and build folders, lock files and minified bundles (a retry goes through).

modelAdvisor.title: Model advisor
modelAdvisor.description: When a heavy model (Opus) is on and the task is light, say once which lighter model fits.

semanticCache.title: Similar-question cache
semanticCache.description: With the local model on, answer a question that means the same as one answered before (a 46 MB local embedding model compares them). Start a prompt with ! for a fresh answer.
